summary: The round-1 minor finding is resolved: all 422 assertions now pin both HTTP status AND the specific AppException business code (CODE_INVALID_TRIGGER_TYPE / CODE_INVALID_TRIGGER_VALUE / CODE_INVALID_KEYWORDS / CODE_INVALID_STEP) via shared assert helpers, so a mis-mapped exception would now fail the test. Helpers reduced duplication without introducing redundancy. All eight TDD anchors remain covered with behavior-asserting tests; tests are green. Approve.
